risks.action: make it fail on purpose before trusting it; add the plant-the-defect probe in the same commit
risks.basis: section 1.1 applies -- A check that stopped checking
risks.risk: a check that cannot fail is indistinguishable from one that is not running

risks.action: search a comment-stripped copy, or parse; if the subject IS the comment, declare it
risks.basis: section 1.2 applies -- Grep cannot tell code from text that describes code
risks.risk: matching a source file by TEXT cannot tell code from a comment or string describing code

risks.action: confirm each shelled command writes nothing; prefer `git show <ref>:<path>`
risks.basis: section 1.4 applies -- A read-only-sounding command that mutates
risks.risk: a read-only-sounding command can write -- `git checkout <ref> -- path` writes AND stages

risks.action: check every caller; the expensive part of a false success is the confident line after it
risks.basis: section 1.5 applies -- The confident line printed after the error
risks.risk: a function reporting failure by return value needs a caller that reads it

risks.action: report what was NOT looked at; a scan that covered 31% and says "clean" is a wrong answer
risks.basis: section 1.7 applies -- A sampling window silently exempts what it does not reach
risks.risk: a fixed window or limit silently exempts whatever it does not reach

risks.action: ask what this does when out of date -- visibly wrong, or quietly passing?
risks.basis: section 1.8 applies -- A generated artefact is safe to generate; a generated GATE is not
risks.risk: a GENERATED artefact is safe; a generated GATE passes when stale

risks.action: sort before emitting; run it twice under different PYTHONHASHSEED
risks.basis: section 1.9 applies -- A checker must answer the same on identical input
risks.risk: set and dict iteration order makes a checker answer differently on identical input
